METHODS

Pipeline & GNN message passing 流程与消息传递

中文

是什么。整个研究的概念流程图。上排五个阶段：数据（标普 500，3 年日线 OHLCV + 价格特征 + 新闻 + 21 日收盘到收盘标签）→ 股票池划分（B 池 10 手工特征 / C 池 51 Alpha158 特征）→ 模型梯子（L0…L7，逐臂调参）→ 两个确认性家族 → 评估（10 seed × 12 季度滚动折）。

怎么看。下方两个放大图。左：调参梯子——L0 LightGBM（基线）→ L1 MLP（无图）→ L2 相关图 GAT → L3–L5 逐步加边 → L6 全注意力 → L7 HATS；底部括号标“无图 / 相关图 / 加额外边类型”。右：GNN 消息传递——一只股票从相关 / 行业 / 新闻邻居聚合信号。

结论。L2 本身就是图（相关边），L3–L5 在其上叠加额外边类型。概念图，不含数据。

English

What it is. The conceptual study pipeline. Top row: Data (S&P 500, 3 yr daily OHLCV + price feats + news + 21-day c-to-c label) → Universe split (B: 10 hand-crafted / C: 51 Alpha158) → Model ladder (L0…L7, tuned per arm) → Two confirmatory families → Evaluation (10 seeds × 12 quarterly folds).

How to read. Two zoom-ins below. Left, the tuned ladder: L0 LightGBM (baseline) → L1 MLP (non-graph) → L2 corr-graph GAT → L3–L5 add edges → L6 full attention → L7 HATS; brackets mark “no graph / corr graph / + extra edge types”. Right, GNN message passing: a stock aggregates from correlation / sector / news neighbours.

Takeaway. L2 is already a graph (correlation edges); L3–L5 stack extra edge types. Conceptual, no data.

§5.1

Headline IC by arm 各臂 IC 水平

中文

是什么。Family-1 的“门面”图。每个模型臂的 IC（信息系数 = 模型打分排名与次日真实涨跌排名的相关度）及 95% 自助置信区间，C 池（上）/ B 池（下）。

怎么看。黑色菱形 + 虚线 = LightGBM 基线（L0），是对照参照（中性色，不代表显著）。蓝色实心 = IC 置信区间不含 0（可靠为正）；灰色空心 = 含 0（测不准）。

结论。所有臂（含 LightGBM）IC 都很小（约 0.01–0.04）且置信区间大幅重叠——没有哪个臂明显胜出。这张只看“水平”；正式“无人打赢 L0”检验在 §5.2。

English

What it is. The Family-1 headline. Each arm’s IC (rank correlation between the model’s score and next-day returns) with a 95% block-bootstrap CI, Univ C (top) / B (bottom).

How to read. The black diamond + dashed line is the LightGBM benchmark (L0), a neutral reference (colour does not imply significance). Filled blue = IC CI excludes 0 (reliably positive); open grey = CI includes 0.

Takeaway. Every arm (LightGBM included) has small IC (≈0.01–0.04) with widely overlapping CIs — no arm clearly wins. Levels only; the formal “no arm beats L0” test is §5.2.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_headline_ic.py
数据 / Data: artifacts/storya_v21_family1/family1_ic_ci.csv
关键数 / Key: C 池 MLP IC=0.034、LightGBM=0.020；多数臂 CI 含 0 / many arms’ CI include 0
§5.2

Hansen SPA + DM/HLN family 统计防御

中文

是什么。Family-1 的统计防御（防 cherry-pick）。左：Hansen SPA 的 p 值，B=0.277、C=0.077，红区 = 拒绝区（p<0.05）。右：20 对 DM/HLN 配对检验森林（C 上 / B 下）。

怎么看。左图两根柱都在红区之上 → 两池都不拒绝原假设 → 没有任何调参臂被确认打赢调参 LightGBM。右图横轴 = ΔIC（arm_A − arm_B），红实心 = BH-FDR 显著、灰空心 = 不显著。

结论。措辞红线：C 池 0.077 只能说“不显著”，禁止“接近显著”。右图显著只是梯子内局部差异，不是“全局打赢 LightGBM”。

English

What it is. The Family-1 statistical defence. Left: Hansen SPA p-values, B=0.277, C=0.077; red band = rejection region (p<0.05). Right: the 20-pair DM/HLN forest (C top / B bottom).

How to read. Both SPA bars sit above the red band → neither universe rejects H₀ → no tuned arm is confirmed to beat tuned LightGBM. In the forest, x = ΔIC (arm_A − arm_B); filled red = BH-FDR significant, open grey = not.

Takeaway. Wording red line: C’s 0.077 is “not significant”, never “near-significant”. The pairwise rejections are local ladder rungs, not global superiority over LightGBM.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_f9_confirmatory.py
数据 / Data: family1_spa.csv · family1_dm_hln.csv · family1_mde.csv
关键数 / Key: SPA B=0.277, C=0.077（皆不拒绝）；DM 11/20 对 BH 显著（局部）
§5.3

Regime dependence 体制依赖性

中文

是什么。信号的“体制集中度”。(a) 热图：行 = 模型臂、列 = 12 季度、颜色 = 该季 IC（红=高、蓝=负），Univ C。(b) 每季平均 IC（B / C 两池柱）。

怎么看。只有少数列深红（2024Q4、2025Q2 尤强），约一半季度淡或偏蓝（≈0 或负）。底部柱图同样显示强弱季交替。

结论。预测信号高度集中在特定市场体制，不稳定。这解释了为什么 headline IC 在留一折（LOFO）下很脆——去掉一个强季度均值就大变。

English

What it is. How concentrated the signal is. (a) Heatmap: rows = arms, columns = 12 quarters, colour = that quarter’s IC (red=high, blue=negative), Univ C. (b) Per-quarter mean IC (bars, B / C).

How to read. Only a few columns are deep red (2024Q4 and 2025Q2 especially); about half the quarters are pale/bluish (≈0 or negative). The bars show the same strong/weak alternation.

Takeaway. The signal is concentrated in specific regimes, not steady — why headline IC is fragile under leave-one-fold-out: dropping one strong quarter moves the mean.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_regime.py
数据 / Data: experiments/storya_v21_main12_tuned/results.csv (+L7)；退化 C/L5s 已排除

§5.4

Cost gross/net 成本（毛/净）口径

中文

是什么。把每句结论拿“扣交易成本后”的经济口径重检。(a) 净 Sharpe vs 成本（0–30bps），C 池关键臂。(b) 散点：横轴 = 毛口径（ΔIC）、纵轴 = 净口径（ΔSharpe@10bps）。

怎么看。(a) 中 LightGBM 扣几个 bps 就转负，MLP / +all / 全注意力仍为正。(b) 中粉色阴影象限 = 两口径符号不一致（成本敏感）；红点 = BH 显著且翻号、蓝 = BH 显著且一致、灰空 = 非 claim。

结论。扣成本后两条主结论（神经网络赢树、图不帮忙）都站得住；BH 显著 claim 里唯一翻号的是 C 池“news 伤排序”——IC 说伤、净 Sharpe ≈ 0（阴影区，fold 脆），不是 news 经济有用的证据。净 Sharpe 描述性，IC 确认性。

English

What it is. Re-checking each claim under a net-of-cost lens. (a) Net Sharpe vs cost (0–30 bps), Univ-C key arms. (b) Scatter: x = gross effect (ΔIC), y = net effect (ΔSharpe @10 bps).

How to read. In (a), LightGBM turns negative after a few bps while MLP / +all / full-attention stay positive. In (b), pink shaded quadrants = the two lenses disagree in sign (cost-sensitive); red = BH-sig & reverses, blue = BH-sig & agrees, open grey = not a claim.

Takeaway. After costs the two headline claims hold; among BH-significant claims the only reversal is Univ-C “news hurts ranking” — gross IC says harm, net Sharpe ≈ 0 (shaded, fold-fragile), not evidence news helps. Net Sharpe descriptive; IC confirmatory.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_cost.py
数据 / Data: artifacts/storya_v21_cost/cost_ladder_by_arm.csv · cost_headline_crosswalk.csv
关键数 / Key: C 池 MLP net@10bps=+0.95 vs LightGBM=−0.22；C news 净 ΔSharpe=+0.08（CI 跨 0）
§5.5

Family-2 causal edge 因果边归因

中文

是什么。Family-2 因果边归因：把容量冻结在 L2 超参上，只改边集，干净隔离“边本身”的效应。每行一个边对比（+news / +sector / +sector+news），C 上 / B 下。

怎么看。蓝实心 + CI = matched-ΔIC（因果主指标）；橙空心方块 = tuned-ΔIC（描述性）；灰带 = ±MDE@80%“测不出区”（蓝点落带内即欠功效）；红连线 = matched 与 tuned 符号相反（容量混淆）。

结论。6 对比 0 个过 BH-FDR、6 个全欠功效 → 边效应方向为正但不可靠。B 池“matched 正 vs tuned 负”翻号揭示：不固定容量时边看着有害，固定后真相是微弱正——“评估不干净会误判边”的活体证据。

English

What it is. Family-2 causal edge attribution: freeze capacity at the L2 hyperparameters and vary only the edge set. One row per edge contrast (+news / +sector / +sector+news), C top / B bottom.

How to read. Filled blue + CI = matched-ΔIC (causal primary); open orange square = tuned-ΔIC (descriptive); the grey band = ±MDE@80% “undetectable zone” (a dot inside = underpowered); a red connector = matched and tuned disagree in sign (capacity confound).

Takeaway. 0 of 6 survive BH-FDR and all 6 are underpowered → edge effects directionally positive but not reliable. The B matched(+)-vs-tuned(−) reversal shows edges look harmful without fixing capacity, but are a tiny positive once fixed — a live demo that unclean evaluation misjudges edges.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_family2.py
数据 / Data: artifacts/storya_v21_family2_fc/family2_fc_causal.csv
关键数 / Key: 0/6 BH-FDR、6/6 欠功效；matched-ΔIC C-L4=+0.014 / C-L5=+0.014（CI 边缘）
§5.7

Listwise-loss inversion 列表损失翻转

中文

是什么。探索性图（非确认性）。损失函数赛马的副产品：MSE / Pairwise / ListMLE 三种排序损失在共享脚手架上的平均 IC（每个 seed×fold cell 取均值后再汇总，±1 标准误）。确认性梯子锁定用 MSE，这里只作失败模式展示。

怎么看。三根柱配 0 参考线。MSE（青）正、Pairwise（紫）≈0、ListMLE（红）显著为负。柱上标注精确均值。

结论。ListMLE 在体制漂移下系统性翻号：其 softmax-似然目标被训练期排序主导，测试期排名一变，损失面反转、模型给出反排名 → 平均 IC=−0.0458（vs MSE +0.0113）。对排序损失从业者的警示。探索性，不进确认性结论。

English

What it is. Exploratory (not confirmatory). A by-product of the loss horse race: mean IC for MSE / Pairwise / ListMLE on a shared scaffold (per-cell mean over seed×fold, then ±1 SE). The confirmatory ladder is locked to MSE; this is shown only as a failure mode.

How to read. Three bars against a 0 reference line. MSE (teal) positive, Pairwise (purple) ≈0, ListMLE (red) clearly negative; exact means annotated on each bar.

Takeaway. ListMLE inverts under regime shift: its softmax-likelihood objective is dominated by the in-distribution rank order, so when test ranks shift the loss landscape inverts and the model produces anti-rankings → mean IC = −0.0458 (vs MSE +0.0113). A caution for ranking-loss practitioners. Exploratory, not a confirmatory claim.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_loss_inversion.py
数据 / Data: experiments/loss_horserace/results.csv
关键数 / Key: listmle mean IC=−0.0458 vs mse=+0.0113（per-cell）
§5.7

Plan-AAA T−1 basis 基础脆弱性

中文

是什么。探索性 caveat 图（Limitation L1）。C 池的特征来自早期 Plan-AAA 的 top-15 Alpha158 组，原排名在当日 OHLC 口径下算的。本图把“原排名”对“严格 T−1 修正后排名”作散点。

怎么看。横轴=原 Plan-AAA 排名，纵轴=T−1 修正后排名；阴影框=top-15 区，虚线=完美稳定。绿星=T−1 后仍留 top-15（5 个），灰圆=掉出（10 个）。

结论。原 top-15 只有 5 个 T−1 后仍 top-15 → C 池特征的选取基础脆弱（L1）。注意：运行时特征确实在 T−1取值（无泄露），脆弱的只是“当初凭什么选这些”的基础。探索性。

English

What it is. Exploratory caveat figure (Limitation L1). Universe C is built from the earlier Plan-AAA top-15 Alpha158 groups, originally ranked under a same-day-OHLC procedure. This scatters the original rank against the rank after strict T−1 leak correction.

How to read. x = original Plan-AAA rank, y = rank after T−1 correction; shaded box = top-15 region, dashed line = perfect stability. Green stars = stay in the top 15 after T−1 (5), grey circles = drop out (10).

Takeaway. Only 5 of the original top 15 stay in the top 15 after T−1 correction → the Universe-C selection basis is fragile (L1). Note: runtime features are evaluated at T−1 (not leaked); only the basis for choosing them is fragile. Exploratory.

脚本 / Script: paper_figs/fig_plan_aaa_t1.py
数据 / Data: artifacts/plan_aaa_t1_diagnostic/group_ranking_comparison.csv
关键数 / Key: 原 top-15 中 5 个存活 T−1（ROC30+5 / KMID+6 / KUP+1 / CNTP20+3 / CORR60）
